summary: Iteration 34: tested repair-fixed tenant notifications, tenant document sharing, and portfolio rent roll (backend 12/12 pytest + frontend UI). Backend fully functional. Frontend rent-roll-screen renders totals/net/received/arrears, year switcher works, empty state shows for a year with no rentals. Row-tap and tenant-docs-picker flows could not be exercised end-to-end in UI because the demo seed has no tenancies in the active project after cleanup; selectors and wiring were verified in code. One minor observation: Snag.out() does not expose tenancy_id or tenant_notified_at, so the owner /api/snags GET response hides those fields even though they're stored and used correctly.

minor.issue: Snag Pydantic model omits `tenancy_id` and `tenant_notified_at`, so these are persisted in Mongo but not surfaced in list/update responses. Clients can't tell if the tenant was notified without an extra DB round-trip. Consider adding them to models.Snag.

action_items: Optional: add `tenancy_id` and `tenant_notified_at` to models.Snag so the owner-facing /api/snags responses include them (currently stored in Mongo but filtered out by Snag.out()).
critical_code_review_comments: notify_tenant_repair_fixed guards tenancy_id/portal_origin https:// correctly and swallows email failures so marking fixed never breaks (good).
share_docs restricts doc_ids to the tenancy's own project_id (good — fails 404 cross-project).
rent-roll endpoint sorts rows by home.arrears desc and converts via live FX cache; excludes land and tenancy-less projects (matches spec).
Minor: GET /api/t/{token}/doc/{did} performs 2 DB lookups; could 404 earlier if did not in shared_doc_ids (already does this - OK).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (rent-roll screen flow + year switcher + empty state; row-tap/portal-sheet verified structurally since demo has no active tenancies)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and then delete: 1 tenancy (TEST_iter34 Alice), 2 snags via tenant-portal repair reports, 1 plain snag, 1 snag_link (TEST_iter34_Boiler_Co), 2 test PDFs. Also 1 land project (TEST_iter34 Land). All removed in teardown. Orphan TEST_iter34 messages (produced by email logs) and leftover snags/snag_links were cleaned explicitly via Mongo. Demo project remains active at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs are auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button (not login-*). Projects screen is opened via home-screen's switch-project-button; rent-roll-button is inside that Projects screen. Email safety: /rentals/tenancies/{tid}/portal rejects http:// origins and only emits the 'View your tenant portal' link in repair-fixed emails if portal_origin starts with https://. For messages, GET /api/messages requires name/email query param to match a stakeholder. Snag model does not surface tenancy_id or tenant_notified_at; verify these via DB directly or by checking /api/messages (kind=repair_fixed).
rca_of_issue: No bugs discovered this iteration. Only a cosmetic model-field omission (see minor backend issue) worth considering but not blocking.
